label: FOUND/EXPLAINED
kernel: FlashMLA SM100 head64 V32 sparse decode core (flash_fwd_splitkv_mla_fp8_sparse_kernel)
role: Attention core, 78 calls/step, ~14.4 us/call (b101); at w4 x top-k 2048 a CTA handles only 1-2 64-token blocks.
pcvs: w 1..4, K 64..256 selected tokens, parts 1..8 (33 states; examples/flashmla_decode grid)
finding: Four DrPerf gaps blocked this kernel and were fixed first: the translated kernel overflowed 128 KiB lane stacks (SIGSEGV); tcgen05.mma completion was free (commit arrived at issue); failed mbarrier try_wait probes counted as work (18% of instructions, path inflated 29%); and the per-site path maximum could not say what a lane waited on. With the critical-lane chain the core reads: consumer (thread 0) waits on the QK MMA [tensor pipe, thread 128]; the MMA issuer waits on the dequant warpgroup (thread 256), the KV gather TMA (thread 192) and the softmax arrive (thread 31); the index/scale warp (thread 224) feeds the gathers. Per task the path is exactly 5326 + 1787 per 64-token block: the steady-state recurrence is QK MMA (~576) -> softmax (~630) -> PV MMA (~512) on the attention loop, not the producers. The index/scale warp loads a block's indices, waits, then issues the dependent scale loads and waits again; its 4-buffer lookahead hides that in steady state, but a one-block CTA (the production case) pays it at start-up.
fix: GLM53_FLASHMLA_INDEX_PREFETCH prototype (gen-glm53-decode-step third_party/flashmla_glm53/decode_head64_kernel_glm53.cuh): indices two blocks ahead, scales one block ahead, same arithmetic. DrPerf: 33/33 reference states pass; one-block path 7113 -> 6756 (-5%), slope unchanged.
fix_status: Prototype; not wired into the build or GPU-timed (expected ~0.02-0.06 ms/step).
timing: Core 14.4 us/call (b101). No GPU measurement of the prototype.
reproduce: DRPERF_GPU_LATENCY_SCHEDULE=block bin/drperf --gpu -- build/core_driver build/flash_core{,_pf}.so build/flash_core{,_pf}.ptx build/flash_aux.so build/flash_aux.ptx grid
credit: DrPerf (after four tool fixes) located the chain and checked the prototype before GPU time.
